questions.question: Main cabin temperature is:
choices: controlled automatically, or by flight crew selection.
controlled by individual passenger.
not controllable at the maximum cabin differential pressure.
Only controllable at maximum cabin differential pressure.
questions.answerText: controlled automatically, or by flight crew selection.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The hydraulic device similar to an electronic diode is a :
choices: check valve.
flow control valve.
distribution valve.
shutoff valve.
questions.answerText: check valve.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The fuel temperature, at which, under standard conditions, the vapour ignites in contact with a flame and extinguishs immediately, is the:
choices: combustion point
fire point
self ignition point
flash point
questions.answerText: flash point
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: Environmental system: in the air refrigeration unit, the water separation unit is placed:
choices: after the cooling turbine.
before the heat exchangers.
before the cooling turbine.
just after the heat exchangers.
questions.answerText: after the cooling turbine.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: There are 60 passengers and crew members on board a turbo-prop aircraft. Its speed is 240 kt. At a point along the course steered, above the sea, the aircraft is at 1h45 min from an airdrome suitable for emergency landing. The minimum equipment complying with regulations is :
choices: 60 life jackets, two 30-seat life boats
60 life jackets and three 30-seat life boats
60 life jackets
One 30-seat life boat and two 20-seat life boats
questions.answerText: 60 life jackets and three 30-seat life boats
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The advantages of grounding the negative pole of the aircraft structure are: 1. Weight saving 2. Easy fault detection 3. Increase of short-circuit risk 4. Reduction of short-circuit risk 5. Circuits are not single-wired lines The combination regrouping all the correct statements is :
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: At constant fuel flow, if engine compressor air is bled off for engine anti-icing or a similar system, the turbine temperature:
choices: will rise.
will be unchanged.
may rise or fall depending on which stage of the compressor is used for the bleed and the rpm of the engine at the moment of selection.
will fall.
questions.answerText: will rise.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: Generally, on modern jet transport aircraft, how can the landing gear be extended if there is a complete hydraulic system failure.
choices: By hydraulic accumulators.
Mechanically
Electrically.
Pneumatically.
questions.answerText: Mechanically
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The output of a generator is controlled by :
choices: varying the length of wire in the armature windings.
the reverse current relay circuit breaker.
varying the field strength.
varying the speed of the engine.
questions.answerText: varying the field strength.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: An accumulator in a hydraulic system will :
choices: increase pressure surges within the system.
reduce fluid temperature and pressure.
reduce fluid temperature only.
store fluid under pressure.
questions.answerText: store fluid under pressure.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: A pneumatic de-ice system should be operated ..
choices: When there are approximately 5 cm of ice on leading edges
Only at take-off and during approach.
When there is approximately 1,5 cm of ice on leading edges.
When entering areas with icing conditions.
questions.answerText: When there is approximately 1,5 cm of ice on leading edges.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The chemical oxygen generator is a system: 1. which is inexpensive 2. requiring no external input 3. which is lightweight 4. requiring no maintenance 5. with adjustable flow rate 6. which is unsafe The combination regrouping all the correct statements is:
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: A DC generator fitted to a aircraft is cooled by :
choices: air tapped from the low pressure compressor.
air via a ram air intake.
water at 8 degrees centrigade from the air-conditioning system.
a fan located before the generator.
questions.answerText: air via a ram air intake.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: Internal leakage in a hydraulic system will cause :
choices: an increased fluid pressure.
an increased fluid temperature.
fluid loss.
a decreased fluid temperature.
questions.answerText: an increased fluid temperature.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The voltage of a fully charged lead-acid battery cell is :
choices: 1,2 volts.
2,2 volts.
1,4 volts.
1,8 volts.
questions.answerText: 2,2 volts.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The VHF Omnirange (VOR) uses the following wavelengths:
choices: centimetric.
metric.
hectometric.
decimetric.
questions.answerText: metric.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The operating principle of float-type carburettors is based on the:
choices: measurement of the fuel flow into the induction system
difference in air pressure at the venturi throat and the air inlet
automatic metering of air at the venturi as the aircraft gains altitude
increase in air velocity in the throat of a venturi causing an increase in air pressure
questions.answerText: difference in air pressure at the venturi throat and the air inlet
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: Turbine blade stages may be classed as either "impulse" or "reaction". In an impulse blade section :
choices: the pressure remains constant across the nozzle guide vanes and rises constant across the rotor blades .
the pressure drops across the nozzle guide vanes and remains constant across the rotor blades .
the pressure rises across the nozzle guide vanes and remains constant across the rotor blades .
the pressure remains constant across the nozzle guide vanes and drops across the rotor blades .
questions.answerText: the pressure drops across the nozzle guide vanes and remains constant across the rotor blades .
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The purpose of the cabin pressure controller, in the automatic mode, is to perform the following functions: 1. control of cabin altitude, 2. control of cabin altitude rate-of-change, 3. limitation of differential pressure 4. balancing aircraft altitude with cabin altitude 5. cabin ventilation 6. keeping a constant differential pressure throughout all the flight phases. The combination regrouping all the correct statements is :
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The most widely used electrical frequency in aircraft is :
choices: 50 Hz.
60 Hz.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: What is breathed in when using a passenger oxygen mask?
choices: Cabin air and oxygen.
100% oxygen.
Cabin air and oxygen or 100% oxygen.
A mixture of oxygen and freon gas.
questions.answerText: Cabin air and oxygen.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The function of a feed box in the fuel tank is to
choices: trap fuel sediments or sludge in the lower part of the tank
distribute the fuel to the various tanks during refuelling
ventilate the tank during refuelling under high pressure
increase the fuel level at the boost pump location
questions.answerText: increase the fuel level at the boost pump location
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: "Nose wheel shimmy" may be described as :
choices: the oscillatory movement of the nose wheel when extended prior to landing.
the amount of free movement of the nose wheel before steering takes effect.
aircraft vibration caused by the nose wheel upon extension of the gear.
a possibly damaging vibration of the nose wheel when moving on the ground.
questions.answerText: a possibly damaging vibration of the nose wheel when moving on the ground.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: When the door operation of a transport airplane equipped with evacuation slides is controlled from the outside, the slide:
choices: is disarmed automatically.
unfolds and becomes inflated.
unfolds but does not become inflated.
becomes inflated in its packboard thus preventing its unfolding.
questions.answerText: is disarmed automatically.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: An asymmetric loading (p-factor) on the propeller exists ..
choices: If there is an unbalanced propeller.
Only for counterrotating propeller
Only if the 'constant speed propeller' mechanism is broken.
If the aeroplane has a large angle of attack.
questions.answerText: If the aeroplane has a large angle of attack.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: An operator shall not operate an aeroplane certicated to JAR25, across an area in which search and rescue would be especially difficult, without survival equipment if it flies away from an area suitable for making an emergency landing at a distance greater than :
choices: 60 minutes at cruising speed.
30 minutes at cruising speed.
120 minutes at cruising speed.
90 minutes at cruising speed.
questions.answerText: 90 minutes at cruising speed.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: Assume a constant speed DC generator providing a constant output voltage. If the electrical load increases, the voltage regulator will :
choices: maintain the intensity of the excitation current constant.
decrease the intensity of the excitation current.
increase the intensity of the excitation current.
change the direction of the excitation current.
questions.answerText: increase the intensity of the excitation current.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: In flight, the most commonly used anti-icing method for the wings of modern commercial aircraft fitted with turbo-jet units is:
choices: Electrical (electrical resistances).
Mechanical (pneumatic source which acts by deforming the profiles of the leading edge).
Thermal (use of hot air).
Physical/chemical (glycol-based liquid).
questions.answerText: Thermal (use of hot air).
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: (For this question use appendix ) Associate the correct legend to each of the numbered diagrams :
choices: 1- half-fork 2- single trace 3- cantilever 4- dual wheels
1- cantilever 2- fork 3- half fork 4- dual wheels
1- half fork 2- fork 3- cantilever 4- tandem
1- cantilever 2- dual wheels 3- half fork 4- fork
questions.answerText: 1- cantilever 2- fork 3- half fork 4- dual wheels
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The difference between (1) a fuse and (2) a circuit breaker is:
choices: (1)not resettable, (2)resettable.
(1) suitable for high currents, (2) not suitable for high currents.fuse circuit breaker
(1) not suitable for high currents, (2) suitable for high currents.fuse circuit breaker
(1)not resettable, (2) not resettable.
questions.answerText: (1)not resettable, (2)resettable.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: A jet aircraft is certified for the carriage of 120 passengers. 42 passenger are on board and the expected Flight Level on route Paris-Alger is FL 330. The first aid oxygen to be on board at departure shall provide breathing supply for at least:
choices: no first aid required.
1 passenger for the entire flight after cabin depressurization at cabin altitude between 10000 and 14000 ft.
3 passengers for the entire flight after cabin depressurization at cabin altitude between 10000 and 14000 ft.
1 passenger for the entire flight after cabin depressurization at cabin altitude of more than 8000 ft.
questions.answerText: 1 passenger for the entire flight after cabin depressurization at cabin altitude of more than 8000 ft.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The correct statement about rain protection for cockpit windshields is that :
choices: the alcohol de-icing system for cockpit windows is also suitable for rain protection
rain repellent should never be sprayed onto the windshield unless the rainfall is very heavy
wipers are sufficient under heavy rain conditions to provide adequate view through the cockpit windows.
the electric de-icing system for cockpit windows is also suitable for rain protection
questions.answerText: rain repellent should never be sprayed onto the windshield unless the rainfall is very heavy
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The purpose of an ignition switch is to :
choices: connect the battery to the magneto
connect the contact breaker and condenser in series with the primary coil
control the primary circuit of the magneto
connect the secondary coil to the distributor
questions.answerText: control the primary circuit of the magneto
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The automatic fuelling shut off valve:
choices: stops fuelling as soon as a certain fuel level is reached inside the tank.
cuts off the fuel in case of engine fire.
stops fuelling as soon as the fuel spills into the ventline.
stops fuelling as soon as a certain pressure is reached.
questions.answerText: stops fuelling as soon as a certain fuel level is reached inside the tank.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: In a "bootstrap" cooling system, the charge air is first compressed in the cold air unit to:
choices: maintain a constant cabin mass air flow.
ensure an adequate pressure and temperature drop across the cooling turbine.
increase the cabin air supply pressure when the charge pressure is too low.
ensure an adequate charge air flow across the inter-cooler heat exchanger.
questions.answerText: ensure an adequate pressure and temperature drop across the cooling turbine.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: With engine fire alarm activated, the extinguisher discharge:
choices: is the pilot's task
is automatic and immediate
is automatic after a delay to allow the pilot to stop the engine
does not need the engine to be stopped
questions.answerText: is the pilot's task
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The function of a fusible plug is to
choices: protect the tyre against explosion due to excessive temperature.
protect the brake against brake disk fusion due to excessive temperature.
function as a special circuit breaker in the electric system
protect against excessive pressure in the pneumatic system.
questions.answerText: protect the tyre against explosion due to excessive temperature.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The mixture control for a carburettor achieves its control by:
choices: altering the depression on the main discharge tube.
varying the air supply to the main discharge tube.
varying the fuel supply to the main discharge tube.
moving the butterfly valve through a separate linkage to the main throttle control.
questions.answerText: varying the fuel supply to the main discharge tube.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: Above what flight level must one pilot wear an oxygen mask at all times during commercial flight.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: Using compressor bleed air to power systems:
choices: has no influence on aircraft performance
increases aircraft performance
is limited to the phases of take-off and landing
decreases aircraft performance
questions.answerText: decreases aircraft performance
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: During climb with constant throttle and RPM lever setting (mixture being constant) the :
choices: RPM increases.
Manifold Air Pressure (MAP) decreases.
RPM decreases.
Manifold Air Pressure (MAP) increases.
questions.answerText: Manifold Air Pressure (MAP) decreases.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: Engine bleed air used for air conditioning and pressurization in turbo-jet aeroplanes is usually taken from the:
choices: by-pass ducting.
compressor section.
fan section.
turbine section.
questions.answerText: compressor section.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: In the axial flow compressor of a turbo-jet engine, the flow duct is tapered. Its shape is calculated so as to:
choices: reduce the axial speed, whatever the engine rating.
maintain a constant axial speed in cruising flight.
maintain a constant axial speed whatever the engine rating.
reduce the axial speed in cruising flight.
questions.answerText: maintain a constant axial speed in cruising flight.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The installation and use of on-board oxygen generators is such that: 1 - the smoking ban is imperative when used 2 - in case of accidental drop of the "continuous flow" passenger masks, no crew action is required 3 - no trace of grease must be found in the system assembly 4 - the system's filling adaptors must be greased with non freezable or graphite grease The combination which regroups all of the correct statements is :
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The power output of a normally aspirated piston engine increases with increasing altitude at constant Manifold Air Pressure (MAP) and RPM because of the :
choices: lower losses during the gas change.
lower friction losses.
leaner mixture at higher altitudes.
lower back pressure.
questions.answerText: lower back pressure.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The torque of an aeroplane engine can be measured at the:
choices: accessory gear box.
camshaft.
gear box which is located between the engine and the propeller.
propeller blades.
questions.answerText: gear box which is located between the engine and the propeller.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The compressor surge effect during acceleration is prevented by the :
choices: Fuel Control Unit (F.C.U.).
inlet guide vanes.
surge bleed valves.
variable setting type nozzle guide vanes.
questions.answerText: Fuel Control Unit (F.C.U.).
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: When an underspeed fault is detected on an AC generator connected to the aircraft AC busbar, the protection device opens the:
choices: exciter breaker.
exciter breaker and generator breaker.
exciter breaker, generator breaker and tie breaker.
generator breaker.
questions.answerText: generator breaker.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: On an aeroplane, spoilers are :
choices: lower wing surface devices, their deflection is always asymmetrical.
upper wing surface devices, their deflection is symmetrical or asymmetrical.
lower wing surface devices, their deflection is symmetrical or asymmetrical.
upper wing surface devices, their deflection is always asymmetrical.
questions.answerText: upper wing surface devices, their deflection is symmetrical or asymmetrical.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: In a hydraulic braking system, the accumulator is:
choices: an accumulator designed to restore brake energy in the event of a hydraulic failure.
a damping type accumulator designed to take up the pressure fluctuations of the automatic braking system.
designed to take up the hydraulic energy filtered by the anti- skid system in order to prevent wheel blocking.
a buffer accumulator whose function is to assist the hydraulic system during high intensity braking.
questions.answerText: an accumulator designed to restore brake energy in the event of a hydraulic failure.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The high Altitude Radio Altimeter uses the following wavelengths:
choices: hectometric.
myriametric.
decimetric.
metric.
questions.answerText: decimetric.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The oil system for a piston engine incorporates an oil cooler that is fitted :
choices: in the return line to the oil tank after the oil has passed through the scavenge pump
between the oil tank and the pressure pump
after the pressure pump but before the oil passes through the engine
after the oil has passed through the engine and before it enters the sump
questions.answerText: in the return line to the oil tank after the oil has passed through the scavenge pump
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The useful work area in an ideal Otto engine indicator diagram is enclosed by the following gas state change lines
choices: 2 adiabatic, 1 isochoric and 1 isobaric lines.
2 adiabatic and 2 isochoric lines.
2 adiabatic and 1 isothermic lines.
2 adiabatic and 2 isobaric lines.
questions.answerText: 2 adiabatic and 2 isochoric lines.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: A propeller blade is twisted, so as to
choices: keep the local Angle of Attack constant along the blade.
avoid the appearance of sonic phenomena.
decrease the blade tangential velocity from the blade root to the tip.
allow a higher mechanical stress.
questions.answerText: keep the local Angle of Attack constant along the blade.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: When the magneto selector switch is set to "OFF" position, the piston engine continues to run normally. The most probable cause of this failure is that:
choices: There is a carbon deposit on the spark plugs electrodes.
A wire from the magneto is in contact with a metallic part of the engine.
There are local hot points in the engine (probably due to overheating of the cylinder heads).
On a magneto, a grounding wire is broken.
questions.answerText: On a magneto, a grounding wire is broken.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The fuel system boost pumps are used to :
choices: avoid the bubbles accumulation and feed the lines with fuel for directing it to the engine at a positive pressure.
avoid the bubbles accumulation.
feed the lines with fuel for directing it to the engine at a positive pressure.
feed the fuel control units, which inject the pressurized fuel into the engine.
questions.answerText: avoid the bubbles accumulation and feed the lines with fuel for directing it to the engine at a positive pressure.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The survival oxygen is:
choices: a therapeutical oxygen specifically carried for certain passengers.
the oxygen supplied to the airplane occupants in case of accidental depressurization.
the oxygen supplied to a passenger who needs oxygen for pathological reasons.
the oxygen used for protection against smoke and carbon dioxide.
questions.answerText: the oxygen supplied to the airplane occupants in case of accidental depressurization.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: (For this question use annex 021- 6660A) The logic symbol shown represents (assuming positive logic) :
choices: a NAND gate.
a NOR gate.
an EXCLUSIVE gate.
an INVERT or NOT gate.
questions.answerText: an INVERT or NOT gate.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: An airplane whose maximum approved passenger seating configuration is greater than 600 seats must be equipped with at least:
choices: 7 hand fire-extinguishers conveniently located in the passenger compartment.
6 hand fire-extinguishers conveniently located in the passenger compartment.
8 hand fire-extinguishers conveniently located in the passenger compartment.
9 hand fire-extinguishers conveniently located in the passenger compartment.
questions.answerText: 8 hand fire-extinguishers conveniently located in the passenger compartment.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: What can be the consequence during a descent with a fully open throttle if the waste gate is seized ?
choices: The turbine blades will separate.
The manifold air pressure (MAP) value may exceed the maximum allowed value.
The power of the motor will decrease.
The turbine shaft will break.
questions.answerText: The manifold air pressure (MAP) value may exceed the maximum allowed value.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: Among the different types of aircraft structures, the shell structures efficiently transmit the: 1. normal bending stresses 2. tangent bending stresses 3. torsional moment 4. shear stresses The combination regrouping all the correct statements is :
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the pack cooling fans in the air conditioning system?
choices: Supplying the heat exchangers with cooling air during slow flights and ground operation.
Supplying the heat exchangers with cooling air during cruise flight.
Supplying the Passenger Service Unit (PSU) with fresh air.
Cooling of the APU compartment.
questions.answerText: Supplying the heat exchangers with cooling air during slow flights and ground operation.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: If one of the 12 cells of a lead-acid battery is dead, the battery:
choices: has 1/12 less voltage, but can still be used.
has 1/12 less capacity, but can still be used.
has 1/12 less voltage and less capacity, but can still be used.
is unserviceable.
questions.answerText: is unserviceable.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The purpose of the barometric correction in a fuel controller is to:
choices: increase the fuel-to-air ratio when altitude increases.
maintain a constant fuel metering whatever the altitude.
maintain the correct weight fuel to air ratio when the altitude increases.
reduce the fuel-to-air ratio when altitude increases.
questions.answerText: maintain the correct weight fuel to air ratio when the altitude increases.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: In accordance with JAR-OPS 1, the minimum requirement for the survival oxygen needed to supply 100 % of the passengers during and following an emergency descend is:
choices: 10 minutes or the entire flight time where the cabin pressure altitude is above 15000 ft, whichever is the greater.
30 minutes.
the entire flight time where the cabin pressure altitude is above 13000 ft.
the entire flight time where the cabin pressure altitude is above 10000 ft minus 30 minutes.
questions.answerText: 10 minutes or the entire flight time where the cabin pressure altitude is above 15000 ft, whichever is the greater.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: (For this question use annex 021-9377A) When fire is detected on engine n°2, the fire shutoff handle n°2 is pulled and the extinguishing agent n°1 is discharged. This results in :
choices: the discharge of fire extinguisher bottle n°1 and illumination of the DISCH (discharge) indicator lamp
the discharge of fire extinguisher bottle n°1 and illumination of the DISCH indicator lamp of agent n°1 on both engines
the discharge of fire extinguisher bottle n°1 and illumination of the DISCH indicator lamp of agent n°1 on engine no. and DISCH indicator lamp of agent n°2 on engine n°1
the discharge of fire extinguisher bottle n°2 and illumination of the DISCH indicator lamp of agent n°1 on engine n°1 and agent n°2 on engine n°2
questions.answerText: the discharge of fire extinguisher bottle n°1 and illumination of the DISCH (discharge) indicator lamp
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: With a piston engine, when detonation is recognised, you:
choices: Reduce manifold pressure and lean the mixture
Increase manifold pressure and enrich the mixture
Increase manifold pressure and lean the mixture
Reduce manifold pressure and enrich the mixture
questions.answerText: Reduce manifold pressure and enrich the mixture
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The function of the Generator Breaker is to close when the voltage of the :
choices: alternator is greater than the battery voltage and to open when the opposite is true
battery is greater than the alternator voltage and to open when the opposite is true
generator is greater than battery voltage and to open when the opposite is true
battery is greater than the generator voltage and to open when the opposite is true
questions.answerText: generator is greater than battery voltage and to open when the opposite is true
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The hydraulic oil, entering the hydraulic pump, is slightly pressurised to :
choices: prevent overheating of the pump.
prevent vapour locking.
prevent cavitation in the pump
ensure sufficient pump output
questions.answerText: prevent cavitation in the pump
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: A public transport jet aeroplane may be operated up to FL 450. The cabin includes 180 passenger seats, made up of 30 rows (3 seats from each side of central aisle). The minimum number of cabin oxygen masks for this aeroplane must be:
choices: 210 (one additional mask per seat row).
198 (110% of the seating capacity).
270 (150% of the seating capacity).
240 (one additional mask per seat block).
questions.answerText: 198 (110% of the seating capacity).
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The pneumatic system accumulator is useful :
choices: to offset for the starting of some devices.
in emergency cases.
to eliminate the fluid pressure variations.
to eliminate the fluid flow variations.
questions.answerText: to eliminate the fluid pressure variations.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: If the cabin altitude rises (aircraft in level flight), the differential pressure:
choices: decreases
increases
remains constant
may exceed the maximum permitted differential unless immediate preventative action is taken.
questions.answerText: decreases
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: Modern pressurized transport airplanes are equipped with :
choices: two oxygen systems both supplying the cockpit and the cabin.
only portable oxygen bottles.
two independent oxygen systems, one supplying the cockpit, the other the cabin.
only one oxygen system supplying the whole aircraft.
questions.answerText: two independent oxygen systems, one supplying the cockpit, the other the cabin.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: A Yaw Damper is :
choices: An elevator augmentor.
An elevator augmentor to avoid the nose-down effect at speeds greater than M=0.8.
A roll trim tab.
A rudder damper designed to avoid the "Dutch roll".
questions.answerText: A rudder damper designed to avoid the "Dutch roll".

adequate voltage differences exists.
questions.answerText: their voltages are almost equal.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: Which of the following qualitative statements about a fixed propeller optimized for cruise condition, is true for the take-off case? The angle of attack of the propeller :
choices: blade is relatively high.
blade is relatively small.
airfoil section is negative.
blades reduces to zero.
questions.answerText: blade is relatively high.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: In a bootstrap cooling system the supply air is first:
choices: passed across an expansion turbine, then directly to the heat exchanger.
compressed, then passed across an expansion turbine through a heat exchanger.
compressed, then goes through a heat exchanger, and across an expansion turbine.
passed across an expansion turbine, then compressed and passed through a heat exchanger.
questions.answerText: compressed, then goes through a heat exchanger, and across an expansion turbine.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: Low oil pressure is sometimes the result of a
choices: too large oil pump
restricted oil passage
too small scavenger pump.
worn oil pump
questions.answerText: worn oil pump
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The portable emergency beacons which are used after an emergency landing or ditching have a duration of :
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The heating facility for the windshield of an aircraft is:
choices: Harmful to the integrity of the windows in the event of a bird strike.
Only used when hot-air demisting is insufficient.
Used only at low altitudes where there is a risk of ice formation.
Used on a continual basis as it reduces the thermal gradients which adversely affect the useful life of the components.
questions.answerText: Used on a continual basis as it reduces the thermal gradients which adversely affect the useful life of the components.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: What will happen to the geometrical pitch angle of a "constant speed propeller" if the manifold pressure is increased ?
choices: It will decrease so that the engine can increase
It will remain the same
It will increase
It will increase and after a short time it will be the same again
questions.answerText: It will increase
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The air-conditioning pack of a present-day aircraft consists of several components: these include two heat exchangers; the primary exchanger (P) and the secondary exchanger (S). The functions of these heat exchangers are as follows:
choices: P: pre-cools the engine bleed air S: increases the temperature of the air used for air- conditioning of cargo compartment (animals).
P: precools the engine bleed air S: reduces the temperature of the air from the primary exchanger or from the pack's compressor.
P: warms up engine bleed air S: recirculates the cabin air, reducing its temperature.
P: warms up engine bleed air S: increases the temperature of air originating from the compressor of the pack.
questions.answerText: P: precools the engine bleed air S: reduces the temperature of the air from the primary exchanger or from the pack's compressor.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The fuel system boost pumps are submerged in the fuel ..
choices: To prime the pumps.
Because their efficiency is greater.
To shorten the fuel lines, so minimising the pressure losses.
To cool the pumps.
questions.answerText: To prime the pumps.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The ABS (Auto Brake System) is being diconnected after landing ..
choices: by pilot action
automatically
at a certain low speed
the system is always armed
questions.answerText: by pilot action
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: On an aircraft provided with resistance and capacitance variation type fire detection loops, a fire alarm is initiated by a temperature increase detected:
choices: on at least one loop
at any isolated point of the loops or else generally on all the loops
only at an isolated point of the loops
only in a uniform way along the loops
questions.answerText: at any isolated point of the loops or else generally on all the loops
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: An aircraft magneto is switched off by
choices: opening the primary circuit
opening the secondary circuit
grounding the secondary circuit.
grounding the primary circuit
questions.answerText: grounding the primary circuit
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: A public transport passengers aircraft, with a seating configuration of more than 61 seats, must have in its passenger compartment(s), at least 3 portable fire- extinguishers including:
choices: 1 halon fire-extinguisher.
3 halon fire-extinguishers.
no halon fire-extinguisher.
2 halon fire-extinguishers.
questions.answerText: 2 halon fire-extinguishers.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: To unfeather a propeller during flight you have to :
choices: gain speed so as to use the engine unfeathering pump.
use the electric unfeathering pump.
manually release the blade latch.
gain speed for aerodynamic unfeathering.
questions.answerText: use the electric unfeathering pump.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The purpose of the venturi in a carburettor is to:
choices: create a rise in pressure at the throat before the mixture enters the induction system.
create the depression necessary to cause fuel to flow through the carburettor jets.
prevent enrichment of the mixture due to high air velocity through the carburettor.
ensure complete atomisation of the fuel before entering the induction system.
questions.answerText: create the depression necessary to cause fuel to flow through the carburettor jets.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: Landing gear torque links are used to:
choices: prevent the extension of the landing gear oleo strut rod.
maintain the compass heading throughout taxiing and take- off.
prevent rotation of the landing gear piston in the oleo strut.
take up the lateral stresses to which the gear is subjected.
questions.answerText: prevent rotation of the landing gear piston in the oleo strut.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: In accordance with JAR-OPS 1, an airplane whose maximum take-off mass exceeds 5 700 kg or whose maximum approved passenger seating configuration is greater than 9 seats and smaller than 200 seats must be equipped with a:
choices: crash axe in the cockpit and a crow-bar in the passenger compartment.
crow-bar in the cockpit and a crash axe in the passenger compartment.
crash axe or a crow-bar in the pilot compartment.
crash axe and a crow-bar in the passenger compartment.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: In the air cycle system the air is cooled down by expansion:
choices: of Freon in a heat exchanger.
of Freon in the turbine.
in the turbine.
in a pressure relief valve.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: A circuit breaker :
choices: may be reset manually after the fault has been rectified.
is self resetting after the fault has been rectified.
can only be reset after major maintenance.
can be reset on the ground only.
questions.answerText: may be reset manually after the fault has been rectified.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: When TAS increases, the pitch angle of a constant speed propeller (RPM and MAP levers are not moved) :
choices: reduces.
first reduces and after a short time increases to its previous value.
stays constant.
increases.
questions.answerText: increases.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

cannot be started with the switch in the ON position
cannot be shut down by turning the switch to the OFF position.
will not operate at the left magneto
questions.answerText: cannot be shut down by turning the switch to the OFF position.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: In some aircraft, there is a protection device to avoid the landing gear being inadvertently retracted on the ground. It consists of :
choices: An aural warning horn.
A warning light which is activated by the WOW (Weight On Wheels) sensor system.
A bolt.
A latch located in the landing gear lever.
questions.answerText: A latch located in the landing gear lever.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The secondary Surveillan ce Radar (SSR) uses the following wavelengths:

centimetric.
hectometric.
myriametric.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: "Conditioned" air is air that has:
choices: oxygen content increased.
oxygen content reduced.
been controled in respect of temperature and pressure.
oxygen content regulated to a preset value.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: With which instrument(s) do you monitor the power output of an aeroplane fitted with a fixed pitch propeller?

RPM indicator.
RPM and Fuel Flow indicator.
RPM and MAP indicator.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

fouled spark plugs
excessive carbon formation in cylinder head.
switch wire grounded

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

choices: prevent the brakes from overheating.
prevent heat transfer from the brake disks to the tyres.
release air from the tyre in case of overpressure.
release air from the tyre in case of overheating.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

in a descent at a fixed throttle setting manifold pressure will always remain constant.
manifold pressure decreases as the aircraft climbs at a fixed throttle setting.
the propeller setting is constant at all indicated airspeeds.

quick removal and installation
absorbing starting loads
providing a retarded spark for engine starting.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The fuel supply system on a jet engine includes a fuel heating device, upstream of the main fuel filter so as to:
choices: maintain and improve fuel heating power.
ease low pressure pumps work by increasing fuel fluidity.
prevent fuel from freezing in fuel pipes due to low temperatures at high altitude.
prevent, at low fuel temperature, the risk of ice formation from water contained in the fuel.
questions.answerText: prevent, at low fuel temperature, the risk of ice formation from water contained in the fuel.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

decrease of air density for a constant quantity of fuel.
constant air density for a bigger quantity of fuel.
increase of air density for smaller quantity of fuel.

density variation of the fuel.
resistivity variation of the fuel.
electrical resistance change.
questions.answerText: dielectric change between fuel and air.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The kind of compressor normally used as a supercharger is :

a piston compressor.
a radial compressor.
an axial compressor.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

choices: High manifold pressure and low revolutions per minute.
High manifold pressure and high revolutions per minute.
Low manifold pressure and high revolutions per minute.
Low manifold pressure and high fuel flow.
questions.answerText: High manifold pressure and low revolutions per minute.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: In a pressurized transport aircraft, the protective breathing equipment:

gives medical assistance to certain passengers with respiratory disorders.
protects all the occupants against the effects of accidental depressurization.

A procedure used in control systems to reduce the stick forces
Temporarily or permanent switching off of certain electric users to avoid overload of electric generators
To leave behind extra cargo if the centre of gravity moves outside limits

Water

Nitrogen

decrease
remain the same
increase or decrease, depending on the engine type

volume of air entering the carburettor is reduced.

centimetric.
metric.

lighter construction.

gradual circumferential increase of tyre wear.
circumferential movement of the tyre in relation to the wheel flange.

questions.question: Where in a hydraulic system might overheat indicators be installed?

In the reservoirs.
At actuators.
At the coolers.

2 hours.

the procedures and checklists for this kind of aeroplanes will take too much time
these aeroplanes often consume too much fuel on short haul flights.

directly maintain a constant proportion between the rpm of engine and generator.
drive the generator at a constant speed.

able to radiotelephone.

the aeroplane's hydraulic system.

diskette drive
keyboard
